cases.sentence: ___ Вронского была опасна, хотя она именовала сердце.
cases.translation: Vronsky's wound was dangerous, though it was near the heart.
cases.explain: «Рана» is the grammatical subject of «была опасна», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он не мог вырвать из своего ___ сожаление о потере её любви.
cases.translation: He could not tear the regret for the loss of her love out of his heart.
cases.explain: The preposition «из» governs the Genitive case, hence «сердца».

cases.sentence: Бетси ездила к ___ и привезла ему отрицательный ответ.
cases.translation: Betsy went to see Anna and brought him a negative answer.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» requires the Dative case, giving «Анне».

cases.sentence: Быстрым шагом Вронский вошёл в её ___.
cases.translation: With a quick step Vronsky entered her room.
cases.explain: «В» with a verb of motion (entering into) takes the Accusative case: «в комнату».

cases.sentence: Варя посмотрела ему в лицо с радостной ___.
cases.translation: Varya looked into his face with a joyful smile.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» meaning "with" (manner) governs the Instrumental case: «с улыбкой».

cases.sentence: Он не мог понять, как могла она думать о ___.
cases.translation: He could not understand how she could think about the divorce.
cases.explain: The preposition «о» ("about") requires the Prepositional case: «о разводе».

cases.sentence: Вронский без малейшего ___ согласился на это предложение.
cases.translation: Vronsky agreed to the proposal without the slightest hesitation.
cases.explain: The preposition «без» always takes the Genitive case: «без колебания».

cases.sentence: Он стал покрывать поцелуями её лицо, руки и ___.
cases.translation: He began covering her face, hands, and neck with kisses.
cases.explain: «Шею» is the direct object of the transitive verb «покрывать», hence Accusative.

reading.ru: Рана Вронского была опасна, хотя она именовала сердце.
reading.question: What kind of wound did Vronsky suffer?
reading.explain: The text says his wound was dangerous, being near the heart.

reading.ru: Когда в первый раз он был в состоянии говорить, одна Варя, жена брата, была в его комнате.
reading.question: Who was in Vronsky's room when he first could speak?
reading.explain: The text says only Varya, his brother's wife, was in his room.

reading.ru: Не отвечая на его слова, Варя нагнулась над ним и с радостной улыбкой посмотрела ему в лицо.
reading.question: How did Varya react on hearing Vronsky speak?
options: She bent over him and looked at him joyfully
reading.correct: She bent over him and looked at him joyfully
reading.explain: The text says Varya bent over him with a joyful smile.

reading.ru: «Не больно тебе?» «Немного здесь», — он указал на грудь.
reading.question: What did Vronsky say when Varya asked if it hurt?
options: A little, here, pointing to his chest
reading.correct: A little, here, pointing to his chest
reading.explain: He said 'a little here' and pointed to his chest.

reading.ru: Несмотря на эти слова и улыбку, которые так испугали Варю, когда прошло воспаление и он стал оправляться, он почувствовал, что совершенно освободился от одной части своего горя.
reading.question: What did Vronsky feel once his wound began to heal?
options: He felt freed from part of his grief
reading.correct: He felt freed from part of his grief
reading.explain: The text says he felt he had completely freed himself from part of his grief.

reading.ru: Он мог спокойно думать теперь об Алексее Александровиче.
reading.question: How did Vronsky now feel about Alexei Alexandrovich?
options: He could think of him calmly
He hated him more than ever
reading.correct: He could think of him calmly
reading.explain: The text says he could now think calmly about Alexei Alexandrovich.

reading.ru: Серпуховской придумал ему назначение в Ташкент, и Вронский без малейшего колебания согласился на это предложение.
reading.question: What assignment did Serpukhovskoy arrange for Vronsky?
reading.explain: Serpukhovskoy devised an appointment for him in Tashkent.

reading.ru: Рана его зажила, и он уже выезжал, делая приготовление к отъезду в Ташкент.
reading.question: What was Vronsky doing as his wound healed?
options: Making preparations to depart for Tashkent
reading.correct: Making preparations to depart for Tashkent
reading.explain: The text says his wound healed and he was preparing for departure to Tashkent.

reading.ru: С этим его посольством Бетси ездила к Анне и привезла ему отрицательный ответ.
reading.question: What answer did Betsy bring back from Anna?
reading.explain: Betsy visited Anna on his errand and brought back a negative answer.

reading.ru: На другой день сама Бетси утром приехала к нему и объявила, что она получила через Облонского положительное известие, что Алексей Александрович дает развод и что потому он может видеть ее.
reading.question: What news did Betsy bring the next day?
options: That Alexei Alexandrovich would grant a divorce
That Anna had left the country
That Anna refused to see him
reading.correct: That Alexei Alexandrovich would grant a divorce
reading.explain: Betsy announced she had received positive news through Oblonsky that Karenin would give a divorce.

reading.ru: Он взбежал на лестницу, никого и ничего не видя, и быстрым шагом, едва удерживаясь от бега, вошел в ее комнату.
reading.question: How did Vronsky enter Anna's room?
options: Quickly, almost running, noticing no one
reading.correct: Quickly, almost running, noticing no one
reading.explain: He ran up the stairs seeing nothing and entered her room almost at a run.

reading.ru: «Мы поедем в Италию, ты поправишься», — сказал он.
reading.question: Where did Vronsky propose they go so Anna could recover?
reading.explain: He said, 'We will go to Italy, you will get better.'

reading.ru: Через месяц Алексей Александрович остался один с сыном на своей квартире, а Анна с Вронским уехала за границу, не получив развода и решительно отказавшись от него.
reading.question: What happened to Alexei Alexandrovich and Anna in the end of this passage?
options: He stayed with their son while Anna went abroad with Vronsky
reading.correct: He stayed with their son while Anna went abroad with Vronsky
reading.explain: The text says Alexei Alexandrovich remained with his son while Anna went abroad with Vronsky, without obtaining a divorce.
